description: Advisory verification feedback; GitHub Actions remains authoritative.

hooks.command: python3 -B -c 'import io,json,pathlib,runpy,subprocess,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); event=json.loads(raw); root=subprocess.check_output(["git","--no-optional-locks","-C",event["cwd"],"rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=1).decode().rstrip("\n"); sys.stdin=io.StringIO(raw); runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(root)/".codex/hooks/quality.py"),run_name="__main__")' 2>/dev/null || printf '{}\n'
